北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气朦胧，体感 -2℃，注意保暖和交通安全哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy, feels like -2℃. Stay warm and safe on the roads!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨绵绵，湿度 94%，出门记得带伞，小心路滑！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain and high humidity. Bring an umbrella and watch for slippery roads!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海雾气弥漫，能见度低，体感 9℃，出行注意安全！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy with low visibility, feels like 9℃. Travel safely!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，气温 21℃，体感舒适。注意早晚温差哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast, 21℃, feels pleasant. Mind the temperature changes.
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，气温 22℃，体感舒适。适合户外活动呢！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy, 22℃, feels comfortable. Good for outdoor activities!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 8℃，风力 3级。出门记得添衣别着凉！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast, feels like 8℃ with moderate wind. Dress warmly to avoid a cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 8℃，有点凉。记得多穿一件衣服哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast, feels like 8℃, a bit chilly. Remember an extra layer!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 21℃，体感舒适。户外活动注意防晒！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, 21℃, feels comfortable. If outdoors, remember sun protection!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 10℃，有点凉意。记得多穿点衣服哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feels like 10℃, a bit cool. Remember to dress warmly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 13℃，湿度 7%，注意补水保湿哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like 13℃, very low humidity. Remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温 21℃，体感舒适。适合出行活动哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, 21℃, feels comfortable. Good for getting out and about!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -14℃，非常寒冷！务必全副武装防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but extremely cold at -14℃! Bundle up warmly!
哈尔滨.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，气温 0℃，体感 -7℃，寒意十足。多穿衣哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast, 0℃, feels like -7℃, quite chilly. Dress warmly!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温 22℃，体感舒适。阳光不错，记得防晒！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is partly cloudy, 22℃, feels comfortable. Nice sunshine, remember sunscreen!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴天，气温 21℃，体感舒适。很适合户外活动！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, 21℃, feels comfortable. Perfect for outdoor activities!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，能见度低，体感 3℃。注意交通安全，穿暖点！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with low visibility, feels like 3℃. Drive safely and dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感 -1℃，很冷。记得多穿衣，做好保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast, feels like -1℃, quite cold. Remember to dress warmly!
